title: SlimyOS Policy
description: Defines what agents are allowed, blocked, escalated, or sandboxed.

default_mode.description: Default disposition for actions not covered by specific rules.

dangerous_actions.description: Tool names that always require approval or are blocked.

blocked_actions.description: Tool names that are always blocked, no override.

blocked_paths.description: Filesystem paths agents may never read or write.

allowed_project_roots.description: Directories where agents may operate freely.

require_snapshot_before.description: Actions requiring filesystem snapshot before execution.

require_approval.description: Actions requiring human approval before execution.

tool_overrides.description: Per-tool policy overrides keyed by tool name.
